facts.fact: The Hollow Moon is a wide white bowl north of Ewe's Rest with a fan of loose stone on its west side; its far rim lies about 10 degrees west of north (about 350 degrees), and the spyglass glint comes from a black outcrop on the west lip at about 315 degrees, above the stone fan. Revises the earlier 210 degrees.
Mini paces the pen wall at twenty-two steps to the wall and about two hundred and four steps round it; Ila's pen figure is about ninety of her own paces.
